name: Jar (Hu)
material: glazed stoneware with incised and applied decoration
dimensions: Diameter: 39.4 cm (15 1/2 in.); Overall: 45.7 cm (18 in.)
summary: This superb Han dynasty jar has a robust shape imitating that of the bronze (hu) and is covered with a thin brownish-green glaze.
